cim_eredeti: A Look at AI, a Lens on Aging
szoveg_eredeti:
BELFAST — The questions range from how to navigate artificial intelligence to how to find connection in life’s later chapters. Belfast Senior College will explore both during two free public events Nov. 9 and 10, pairing a practical technology presentation with the world premiere of a movie created through one of its classes.

Doug Chamberlin, presenter for AI: A Look at Artificial Intelligence.

The programs begin Monday, Nov. 9, with “First Look at AI,” presented by Doug Chamberlin from 4 to 5:30 p.m. in the Abbott Room at the Belfast Free Library. Co-sponsored by the library, the presentation will examine artificial intelligence from the average person’s perspective, addressing what it is, how people can use it and how they can protect themselves from its risks.
